headline: Rohit Sipahimalani, chief investment officer of Singapore's state investor Temasek, named AI spending and inflation as the biggest risks to markets in 2027.
score_reason: Lowered from 6: only a thin secondary summary could be read and the Bloomberg original was blocked.
importance_line: Investors and anyone with savings in stock or bond funds could be hit if AI profits disappoint or inflation lifts bond yields, but the warning is a general outlook with no dates or figures.
summary: Bloomberg reports, as summarised by GuruFocus, that Temasek's chief investment officer Rohit Sipahimalani said at the Milken Institute Asia Summit on 6 Oct 2026 that the biggest risks to markets next year are AI investments and inflation pushing up bond yields. He said turbulence in the AI sector could come as early as 2027, as debate grows over whether tech firms' huge AI spending will pay off.
notes: Bloomberg blocked (403). Read only GuruFocus's short summary (it adds stock-valuation filler about TSMC that is not used); Bloomberg is credited as the original reporter per the headline. Detail is thin; Bloomberg's own text was not seen. The GuruFocus summary dates the remarks 6 Oct 2026.
